item.title: Letter to the Editor: A CALL TO PROTECT OUR SKIES
item.description: Editor, Roadrunner: Many of us chose Valley Center for the peace and “rural character” promised by the San Diego County General Plan. But, that tranquility is being replaced by a relentless and escalating noise crisis in our skies.
